text:
ash: quick heads-up — seeing an 8-12% drop in KV prefix cache hit-rate for chat+RAG after the kernel-selection swap on staging.

kevin: same on canary, noticed p50 +3ms and tail widening.

ash: profiling summary:
- overall prefix hit-rate: 78% -> 70%
- identical-key matches down 40%
- hit-rate drop concentrated on short prefixes (<32 tokens)
- increased unique-key cardinality by ~18%

sasha: do we have a diff of the keying function? maybe kernel changed token offsets causing different normalized prefixes.

ash: earlier key: 
```
// kv_key = sha1(prefix_text)
normalize(prefix_text) -> trim -> lower -> collapse_whitespace
```
after change (kernel):
```
// kv_key = sha1(prefix_tokens)
tokenize(prefix_text) -> join(token_ids)
```
so hit alignment broke for flows that relied on whitespace normalization (RAG prep, assistant priming).

maria: interesting — tokenization-based keys are more deterministic across runtimes but sensitive to tokenizer version/offsets. we should add a hybrid fingerprint that uses normalized text plus tokenized signature.

kevin: proposal: make kv key = sha1(norm_text) + "-" + sha1(first_16_token_ids). That preserves text-level equivalence while de-duplicating by token prefix when possible.

sasha: will that increase key size? and collision risk?

maria: key length grows but we already store 256-bit hashes; concatenation can be hashed again. collision risk negligible vs current.

ash: I'll implement a canary: 10% traffic for 2 hours; metrics to track: cache_hit_rate, cache_evictions_per_min, p50/p95 latency tokens/sec.

kevin: add a fine-grained metric: cache_hit_by_prefix_len and cache_hit_by_source (chat|completion|rag|structured).

sasha: also add a synthetic workload that mimics multi-turn chat with reused system and user priming. I have a harness.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z (epoch 1912350400)

ash: thanks. action items:
- ash: implement hybrid fingerprint + unit tests
- sasha: synthetic harness + collision sims
- kevin: dashboard panels + alert for >5% regression vs baseline
- maria: review rollout policy and fallback to tokenized-only keys

kevin: baseline expectation is recovering ~6-9% hit-rate and p50 latency ~1-2ms improvement on heavy chat RAG.

maria: if canary looks good escalate to 50% then 100% with 1h observation windows.

ash: ping me if you see unexplained key churn. I'll post perf logs after the first run.

kevin: thanks — will watch graphs.

sasha: adding PR link when ready :link:
